name: crew
description: Crew: suggests the 5 session agents that fit your request, drafts a task prompt with Haiku and starts the agent in the background, from its own pane

crewRun.title: Crew run
crewRun.description: draft: the model writes a task prompt and waits for start, edit or drop; direct: the agent starts at once with that prompt

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: theme follows your Claude Code theme (light, dark, colour-blind); pastel is fixed colours tuned for dark terminals

autoOpen.title: Open automatically
autoOpen.description: Open the pane when Crew has agents to suggest for a prompt
